documentGenerationDescription: Generate official investigation documents for this case.
medicalExaminationRequisitionDescription: Generate a requisition letter requesting medical examination of the victim or accused.
policeRemandApplicationDescription: Prepare an application requesting police custody remand of the accused before the court.
chargesheetDescription: Generate the final chargesheet containing investigation findings, evidence, witnesses, and applicable legal sections.
supplementaryChargesheetDescription: Create an additional chargesheet to submit newly discovered evidence or investigation findings.
seizureMemoDescription: Generate a seizure memo documenting all articles, property, and evidence seized during the investigation.
sceneOfOffencePanchnamaDescription: Prepare a detailed panchnama describing the crime scene, observations, and recovered evidence.
courtCustodyWarrantDescription: Generate the warrant and commitment memo for transferring the accused to judicial custody.
faceIdentificationMemoDescription: Prepare a suspect identification memo containing photographs, physical features, and identification marks.
